metric_definitions.TTT: Sum of scheduled-demand time until network exit or the actual evaluator stop; unfinished demand is censored, so early-stop exposure is not full-budget travel time.
metric_definitions.approach_gap: Largest minus smallest N/E/S/W mean incoming wait; N/A unless all approaches are observed. No combined fairness score.
metric_definitions.architecture: Runtime guard counts training, backward, optimizer, parameter changes, critic calls and centralized execution attempts; checks unchanged E5 and <=4 negotiators.
metric_definitions.completion: Vehicles leaving the network / scheduled vehicles; unfinished trips remain visible.
metric_definitions.fallback_rate: MAPPO epochs requiring safety fallback / MAPPO epochs; N/A with no MAPPO epochs. A fallback is not direct MAPPO success.
metric_definitions.inversion: Fraction of physically conflicting, different-approach served pairs whose service order differs from arrival order; N/A without eligible served pairs.
metric_definitions.safety: Observed simulator collisions and blocked-zone entry invariant violations.
metric_definitions.scalability: Measured maximum live/moving vehicles, incoming queue depth per approach, and simultaneous negotiating participants.
metric_definitions.throughput: Completed vehicles per observed simulated minute; compare alongside stop time and completion.
metric_definitions.waiting: Observed time below the existing 0.5 m/s threshold on incoming lanes, including followers. Unfinished waits are lower bounds; unspawned demand is N/A.

note: Preflight, replays, qualitative demonstrations and comprehensive final evaluation are excluded from these panel case results.
scope: One selected unsignalized four-way SUMO intersection; AV-only, one incoming lane per approach, 12 legal movements, ideal same-step messages, <=4 physical queue-head negotiators; up to 16 total traffic vehicles.
